dataset.description: Images of works of contemporary art, and exhibition documentation, in Latvia (approximately by 20-30 authors), that contain references to the vegetal world, especially - where the agentic power of plants is articulated, creatively employed, and communicated to the audience.

distribution.title: The data will provide a collection of works of eco-conscious contemporary art in Latvia that engage with the agency of plants.

dataset.title: Images
